self_review_state_machine.goal_ownership: The SELF_REVIEW_GOAL owns the loop. Todo/iteration/generation completion has zero exit authority.

states.ACTIVE: Goal loaded; next healing iteration may start (memory-commit invariant must be satisfied).
states.TESTING: Experiment implemented, compiling, or running on physical MT5.
states.REASSESSING: Iteration complete, goal unmet; learning committed; next highest-EIV action selected under SAME goal.
states.PASSED: All mandatory module gates met (WR>=70%, PF>=2.00, Payoff>=1.00, Freq>=20/yr, validation pass). Routes to Independent Reviewer.
states.ESCALATING: Safety ceiling or repair-level EIV exhaustion. Routes to Head Quant / Research Governor. NOT completion.
states.BLOCKED: Genuine external blocker (MT5/data/gateway). Checkpointed; restart resumes SAME goal.
states.EXHAUSTED: All five repair levels exhausted; thesis review / family pivot required.

transitions.note: module frozen, mission stays ACTIVE, next portfolio goal opens
SAME goal reopened with objections as constraints
